tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: List book types, shipping countries and photo requirements. Free.

tools.name: compare_photo_book_prices
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what a photo book (Dutch: fotoboek) costs, how foto foto's price compares with other services, how long delivery takes or the last day to order for Christmas, or which services sell a layflat book, a linen cover or fine-art paper. Prices one book (binding, cover, paper, pa

tools.name: start_photo_book
tools.description: Use this when someone wants to make a printed photo book (Dutch: fotoboek) or photo album but has not shared any photos yet. Shows a card where they pick the photos, in order, right here. Nothing is ordered or charged.

tools.name: create_book
tools.description: Use this when the person wants a photo book (Dutch: fotoboek) made from photos they attached, direct image links, or a public iCloud Shared Album link. Designs a draft book from the photos in the supplied order; nothing is ordered or charged. Photos the person attached in this chat go in attachments

tools.name: get_book
tools.description: Use this to show a book that was already made, or to get its price for one copy including shipping when country is supplied. Needs the book's private bookToken. Photos, cover, title, layout and materials are changed in the foto foto editor.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Use this when the person pays for the book themselves. Prepares a Stripe checkout link for the book, using the bookToken. The book does not need to be saved first. Stripe collects their email, delivery address and payment; no charge occurs until they confirm there. Collect the destination country fi

tools.name: create_payment_quote
tools.description: Use this when you pay for the book on the person's behalf. Prepares a fixed payment quote for a printed book, including shipping, for MPP and, when listed, x402 (USDC on Base). Requires a complete delivery address, and email for the order confirmation when the book is not saved to an account yet. No

tools.name: pay_book
tools.description: Buy the exact quoted book using native MPP. Only after the buyer approves its total and delivery address. Supply quoteId and bookToken. A payment challenge is returned through JSON-RPC; retry the same call with the authorized payment credential in _meta. This charges the buyer.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "compare_photo_book_prices" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
